subject: Post-call: Elara Health compliance checklist & questionnaire
content:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Elara Health compliance checklist & questionnaire

Hi Maya — great to meet earlier. Thanks for walking us through Elara's roadmap. Quick recap from our side and next steps: 

1) SOC 2 status: you mentioned SOC 2 Type II in progress, targeted completion end of Q4. Please share the most recent SOC 2 readiness summary and scope (systems in / out).
2) Data residency & GDPR: Elara will require EU data processing addendum for EU customers. We'll prepare the DPA draft and send it to procurement.
3) HIPAA: you indicated PHI is in scope for one product line — we'll flag the design for Private deployment and KMS integration.
4) Questionnaire: attached is a concise security questionnaire (XLSX) we use to prioritize follow-ups — if you can fill tabs 1–3 that will let our security team triage.
5) Timeline & milestones: proposed mutual action plan attached (high level).

Immediate asks (can we aim for these by Fri 9/11?):
- Elara to return questionnaire (tabs 1–3)
- Share SOC 2 readiness summary (PDF)
- Confirm primary procurement contact for contract/legal review

Attaching: Elara_Security_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx (please return; small), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (overview).

I'll also loop in Hannah (security) and Neha (solutions) to run a short technical sync. Thanks — talk soon.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

-----
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@elarahealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elara Health Procurement <procurement@elarahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Elara Health compliance checklist & questionnaire

Thanks, Sergio — appreciate the clear recap. A couple of clarifications: 
- SOC 2: our SOC 2 Type II audit is underway; we have a readiness report from our consultant dated 2026-08-20. I will attach that to the questionnaire responses.
- HIPAA: PHI is processed for our remote-monitoring product; we expect Business Associate Agreement language to be required.
- Procurement contact is Rajesh Iyer (procurement@elarahealth.com) — he's looped here.

We should be able to return the filled questionnaire by Friday (9/11). If anything slips, we'll flag by Wednesday.

Best,
Maya

-----
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@elarahealth.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 12:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Elara Health compliance checklist & questionnaire

Hi Maya — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few notes from the technical side so you know what we'll review once we get the questionnaire: 
- For HIPAA: we'll outline Private deployment options with VPC peering and customer-managed KMS; we'll also document our BA obligations and logging capabilities.
- For SOC 2: please call out which services/assets you expect to be in-scope (e.g., embeddings store, user prompt logs). That will help Hannah scope controls and evidence.
- For GDPR: we'll include standard DPA language; the Console supports region routing for inference.

I'll coordinate a 30-min technical sync with Hannah and your engineering lead once we have the questionnaire back. Proposed window: next Tue (9/14) morning PT.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@elarahealth.com>, Elara Health Procurement <procurement@elarahealth.com>

Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Elara security questionnaire + proposed MAP

Maya / Rajesh — forwarding the questionnaire again in case it wasn't obvious from my first message. I attached a short mutual action plan with milestones tied to SOC 2 evidence delivery and contract review. Quick highlights: 
- Week 1 (by 9/11): questionnaire returned + SOC 2 readiness doc
- Week 2 (by 9/18): technical sync + draft DPA shared by Redwood legal
- Week 4 (by 10/02): contract redlines completed, SOC-in-scope confirmation

If procurement prefers a DocuSign link for the MSA, we can prepare that once redlines are agreed.

Attachment: mutual-action-plan-elara-20260909.pdf (stub).

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@elarahealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Elara Health compliance checklist & questionnaire

Thanks all. Quick internal notes on evidence and scope so Elara knows what we'll be asking for: 
- SOC 2 evidence: control matrices, recent vulnerability scan summaries, change management logs (3 months), and user access reviews. If the readiness report is detailed, that will speed triage.
- ISO 27001 / FedRAMP: you flagged potential long-term interest in ISO and FedRAMP. We'll provide high-level mapping of current SOC controls to ISO 27001 clauses; FedRAMP is a multi-quarter lift and we'll share recommended phased approach if you want to explore that path.
- HIPAA specifics: we will surface audit logging, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, and BAAs in the DPA draft.

Action items (Hannah): create a short evidence checklist (PDF) to accompany the questionnaire; share with the thread by Mon 9/13.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
